scenes.title: A comfortable seat
scenes.cameraAction: Before331. Wide enough to establish PinPin seated on small flat stone rearRIGHT beyond Elder, smiling at both adults. Same grown stool330 center, BeaverLEFT with shears safely lowered, ElderRIGHT. No harvested pile yet.

en: PinPin found a little stone seat. He could see them both.
ru: Пин-Пин устроился на плоском камешке. Отсюда ему были видны оба.
es: PinPin se sentó en una piedra plana. Desde allí podía ver a los dos.

scenes.title: A blink
scenes.cameraAction: After331. Close Elder reaction only: blink, slight parted lips, gaze down at freshly cut stool. First cut bundle still held or cropped. No regrowth yet; Beaver offscreen.

en: The Elder blinked. He looked at the little stump.
ru: Старейшина моргнул. И посмотрел на маленький пенёк.
es: El Anciano parpadeó. Miró el pequeño tocón.

scenes.title: Oh thank you
scenes.cameraAction: After340 before341. Beaver left looks UP from intact regenerated shoots toward Elder gratefully, free paw open, CLOSED shears low. No cutting. One prior bundle rearLEFT; seated smiling PinPin rearRIGHT if visible.

scenes.title: Following the game
scenes.cameraAction: After341. Close seated PinPin, amused attentive eyes toward BeaverLEFT; adult shoulders may frame edges. Same rearRIGHT stone seat. No worry. Two-bundle pile if visible, cut stool.

en: Snip… grow… snip. PinPin looked from one to the other.
ru: Щёлк… расти… щёлк. Пин-Пин переводил взгляд с одного на другого.
es: Clic… crece… clic. PinPin miraba a uno y luego al otro.

scenes.title: The same little stump
scenes.cameraAction: After357 before342. Elder close-medium eyes from second harvested pile to stump, one eyebrow gently raised. A tiny held breath, not fatigue or anger. No plant growth in this reaction frame. PinPin seated amused rearRIGHT if included.

en: The Elder looked at the stump again. One eyebrow went up.
ru: Старейшина снова посмотрел на пенёк. Одна бровь чуть приподнялась.
es: El Anciano volvió a mirar el tocón. Una ceja se levantó un poquito.

scenes.title: Thank you again
scenes.cameraAction: After342 before343. Beaver gratefully faces Elder, intact regenerated shoots, CLOSED shears lowered, earnest small nod. Two harvested bundles fixed rearLEFT. No snip yet.

scenes.title: A hidden smile
scenes.cameraAction: After343. Same seated PinPin stone rearRIGHT, looks toward ElderRIGHT instead of previousBeaverLEFT, one paw lightly covers small amused smile. No concerned expression, no standing. Three-bundle pile if visible.

en: PinPin hid a little smile behind his paw.
es: PinPin escondió una sonrisa detrás de la patita.

scenes.title: One moment
scenes.cameraAction: After360 before344. Elder quiet reaction, one finger half-raised, controlled bemused expression, looks from third pile to same cut stool; Beaver turns back toward pile. No growth, no thanks, no cutting within this frame.

en: The Elder raised one finger. Beaver was already turning away.
ru: Старейшина поднял один палец. А Бобр уже отвернулся.
es: El Anciano levantó un dedo. Castor ya se estaba dando la vuelta.

scenes.title: Lovely branches
scenes.cameraAction: After344 before345. Beaver grateful small nod toward Elder, regenerated rods uncut, shears firmly CLOSED and lowered; three harvested bundles remain. PinPin seated amused rearRIGHT if visible.

scenes.title: A giggle waiting
scenes.cameraAction: After346 before347. Hold anticipation, medium seatedPinPin delighted suppressing giggle, gazes at Elder; adult Elder background holdingstaff consideringstool, Beaver at largerpile. No spell yet, no worry. Shears on bench per346.

en: PinPin pressed his lips together. A giggle was trying to escape.
ru: Пин-Пин сжал губы. Смешок так и просился наружу.
es: PinPin apretó los labios. Una risita quería escaparse.

en: ‘Grow, little willow. Reach for the sun,’ he whispered.
ru: «Расти, ивушка. Тянись к солнышку», — прошептал он.
es: «Crece, pequeño sauce. Busca el sol», susurró.

en: ‘Grow, little willow. Open your leaves,’ he whispered.
es: «Crece, pequeño sauce. Abre tus hojas», susurró.

en: ‘Grow, little willow. Reach for the sun.’
